source: Scientific metric and comparison configuration of the recorded final analysis.
scope: Offline replay of final MovieLens feedback, agent-ablation, mitigation, and Goodreads comparisons.

common.iterations: Full trajectories 1--30, equal-weight mean of all 30 iteration values, and iteration-30 endpoint.
common.partial_runs: List pending/incomplete conditions explicitly. Only complete source pairs enter main comparisons; never substitute a different epoch budget or active/reserve protocol.
common.undefined: Undefined metric denominators remain missing; a primary 30-iteration mean requires all 30 iteration values defined. No-click and invalid counts remain visible.
common.effects: Signed treatment-minus-control differences, paired within dataset, study protocol, seed/population, and iteration. Share differences are percentage points.
common.replication: Seed/population blocks are the campaign replicates. Users, iterations, model pairs, and physical-control aliases do not add independent replications. No pseudoreplicated significance tests.
common.rank_discount: d(r)=1/log2(r+1), ranks r=1,...,K. First weights 1, 0.63093, 0.5. Normalise by displayed weight in the stated label scope.
common.exports: Every notebook writes plot PNG/PDF and LaTeX tables with labels chap:results:tab:analysis_name, plus full-precision CSV and source metadata.

research_questions.title: Feedback mechanisms
research_questions.question: How do popularity bias trajectories change as additional feedback mechanisms are introduced?
comparisons: L1 minus L0 within the same response model
L2 minus L1 within the same response model
Full-reflection L3 minus frozen-agent L2
Each L4 departure/refill variant minus matched 150-active/150-reserve L3
Static advertising minus candidate-restricted matched organic advertising control
Adaptive L5 advertising minus static advertising

research_questions.title: User-response models
research_questions.question: How do bias trajectories differ between user-response models under comparable feedback conditions?
comparisons: Response models at the same L0, L1, or L2 stage and seed/population
Model-specific L1-minus-L0 and L2-minus-L1 effects
Canonical versus identical-order replica and shuffled probes from the same pre-update opportunity

sections.focus: Bias trajectories and selection relative to exposure

sections.definition: LLM: replica minus shuffled same-item agreement on common all-valid-click triples. Computational: TVD between saved click-probability distributions aligned by item identity, not displayed rank.
Compare canonical and shuffled displayed ranks; order effects cannot be inferred from canonical ranks alone.

research_questions.title: Agent ablations
research_questions.question: How do the tested memory and reflection configurations affect simulated user behaviour and bias trajectories?
comparisons: L3 no reflection minus L2 frozen agent: private factual memory
L3 fixed profile minus L3 no reflection: reflection notes
L3 full reflection minus L3 fixed profile: applied profile updates

sections.definition: Select ten distinct users with at least one actual applied profile update per seed in main full-reflection L3, using the simulation seed; report fewer if fewer qualify. Provide evidence, but leave manual judgements unfilled.

research_questions.title: Mitigation
research_questions.question: How does the effectiveness of bias mitigation depend on the user-response model?
comparisons: Each in-processing and post-processing treatment minus its own unmitigated model/stage/seed/population control
In-processing minus post-processing within the same configuration
Between-model control differences versus each model's mitigation effects

sections.definition: Report total, immediate-reranking, and feedback/state components within every matched seed and iteration. For head-click share use post canonical minus control canonical, post canonical minus post original_order_probe, and post original_order_probe minus control canonical. For exposure use presented versus original recommender slates; a pure permutation has zero immediate unweighted exposure effect. Each arm retains its own valid-click denominator. The feedback component is the remaining difference under the treated trajectory, including state changes and response variation, not an isolated causal feedback estimate.

Keep each model pair, seed/population, and metric explicit; compare with the absolute own-control mitigation change. Reflective-agent L3 versus other-family L2 is a model-configuration comparison, not an isolated response-model effect.

research_questions.title: Order sensitivity
research_questions.question: To what extent is sensitivity to recommendation order associated with the effectiveness of our post-processing mitigation?
comparisons: Baseline unmitigated-control order sensitivity versus control-minus-post-processing head-click share, separately within each seed/population

sections.definition: Positive reduction is control minus post-processing, in percentage points.

One model-level observation per seed; retain all input pairs. LLM agreement gaps and computational probability TVD are distinct estimands and cannot be silently pooled. Report descriptive within-family associations where at least three nonconstant input pairs exist; no p-values or validated-prediction claim.

research_questions.title: Goodreads popularity
research_questions.question: How well do findings on popularity bias generalise to the Goodreads dataset for selected conditions?
comparisons: Goodreads computational and Direct LLM L2 minus L0 with corresponding MovieLens contrasts for seeds 42, 43, and 44
Goodreads reflective L3 minus frozen L2 with corresponding MovieLens contrasts for seeds 42, 43, and 44
Where complete, supplementary L1-minus-L0 and L2-minus-L1 computational decompositions from the extension

research_questions.title: Goodreads author-gender representation
research_questions.question: To what extent do selected findings about user-response models, feedback mechanisms, and mitigation extend from popularity bias in MovieLens to author-gender representation in Goodreads?
comparisons: Unmitigated computational and Direct LLM L2 minus L0, and reflective L3 minus frozen L2, for seeds 42, 43, and 44
Computational gender in-processing and post-processing minus their own control within the same stage/model/seed/population
In-processing minus post-processing within each computational stage/model/seed/population

sections.definition: All displayed slots or all valid clicks in denominator, including unknown and ambiguous labels.
Women numerator divided by women-plus-men mass within each iteration; weighted exposure uses the same label scope in numerator and denominator. Undefined if no qualifying mass.
